scope: Five fixed original test modules, their Python wrapper and collector, and three directly referenced shell scripts; no original test or product source changes.
reason: Python 3.10 introduced the runtime type union operator. Neither Python production module postpones annotations. Importing run_bazel_with_buildbuddy reaches remote_config line 117; loading the collector reaches collect line 101. Python 3.9 cannot evaluate these existing annotations. This is a static language/API finding, not an observed Python execution.

interpreter_binding.parent: The original unittest discover must use an actual compatible interpreter.
interpreter_binding.children: run_bazel_with_buildbuddy.py uses /usr/bin/env python3; run-bazel-ci.sh invokes python3 for collection, so the subprocess PATH must resolve the same compatible interpreter.
interpreter_binding.fixture_PATH: The original test fixture preserves inherited PATH; its environment filter removes only BAZEL_, BUILDBUDDY_, CODEX_BAZEL_, GITHUB_ prefixes. It finds bash via shutil.which.
interpreter_binding.ci_reported_action: Use the same Python directory plus system directories in both original and repaired phases; assert real /bin/bash; no Python 3.9 baseline executed.
interpreter_binding.observation_scope: Interpreter paths and versions in this object come from the CI agent message, not an independent native query by this reviewer.

other_api_scope: Path.is_relative_to is documented as available in Python 3.9 and is not this incompatibility.
No runtime compatibility or 57-test success is inferred from AST parsing or source review.
